## Summary

I have implemented the complete React frontend UI for the Boss Recruiter application following the claude.ai style. Here's what was created:

### Files Created

**Store:**
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/stores/appStore.ts` - Zustand store with sessions, messages, settings, candidates, exported files, and UI state management

**Hooks:**
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/hooks/useApi.ts` - API hook for backend communication on port 3001

**Components:**
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/ThemeProvider.tsx` - Dark/light theme context provider
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/ChatArea.tsx` - Main chat area with message list, input box, and claude.ai styling
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/LeftSidebar.tsx` - Collapsible sidebar with session list, New Chat button, and settings (export path, theme toggle)
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/RightSidebar.tsx` - Collapsible sidebar with file tree for exported files
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/CandidateCards.tsx` - Candidate popup with horizontal scrollable cards, list view toggle, sort by match score
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/LoginModal.tsx` - Login modal with phone input, verification code, slider verification
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/AppLayout.tsx` - Main layout combining all components

**Updated Files:**
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/App.tsx` - Updated to use ThemeProvider and AppLayout
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/index.css` - Added custom scrollbar, animations, and base styles
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/components/index.ts` - Exports all components
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/hooks/index.ts` - Exports hooks
- `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/agent-browser/boss-recruiter/client/src/stores/index.ts` - Exports store and types

### Features

- **Dark/Light Theme**: Full support with toggle, persisted to localStorage
- **Chat Interface**: Message bubbles, markdown rendering, copy button, loading states
- **Session Management**: Create, switch, delete chat sessions
- **Candidate Cards**: Horizontal scrollable cards, list view, sort by match score/name, export functionality
- **Exported Files**: File tree view with preview, delete, and copy path
- **Login Modal**: Phone authentication with verification code and slider verification
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-friendly with collapsible sidebars
- **Tailwind CSS**: Using zinc color palette, primary accent colors, rounded corners, subtle borders

The project builds successfully with no TypeScript errors.
